original_test_intent: Verify that every SMBIOS Type 8 record reports the approved External Connector Type enum for its external endpoint, including a valid None value for an internal-only connector where specified, and that the complete mapping remains unchanged after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw and decoded Type 8 records, retain the raw external-connector enum together with handle, both designators/types and port type, compare each record to the approved board connector map, then repeat after an approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the record-level connector map, handling of None/unknown/vendor values and reboot plan. Physical connector inspection or link testing is optional separate scope, not part of this metadata acceptance.
required_inputs: Expected external connector type per Type 8 handle/port
Board/chassis revision and internal/external connector map
Applicable SMBIOS version and raw enum definitions
Policy for None, unknown, out-of-range and vendor-defined values
Validated Type 8 parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not connect, disconnect or probe ports.
Preserve raw enum bytes and complete Type 8 identity because decoded labels can vary by tool/version.
Do not reject None when the record intentionally lacks an external endpoint, and do not accept unknown/vendor values without an approved definition.
Do not infer physical connector geometry, population or functional link behavior solely from SMBIOS metadata.
Stop on malformed records, unsupported enum interpretation, record-map mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect and decode every Type 8 record, map raw external connector enums to approved definitions and compare the complete table before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate connectors, claim physical functionality or issue the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the board connector map and enum/exception policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, arrange separate physical or link inspection only if required, and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The requested field is correct, but grep fragments omit the record handle, paired designators/types, port type and raw enum needed to identify repeated records and validate decoder output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 8 data and compare each raw External Connector Type enum in full record context against a version-aware board map before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The External Connector Type scope, Type 8 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the raw external-connector enum and decoded label for each complete Type 8 record using the applicable SMBIOS definition and approved board map, with explicit None/unknown handling and pre/post-reboot comparison.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/chassis revision and dmidecode/parser versions; interpret enums against the applicable SMBIOS version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 8 Connector Type enumeration, approved board/chassis connector map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum preservation, full record attribution and valid no-external-endpoint semantics instead of relying on isolated decoded text.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; improves detection of decoder drift, misbound connector records and invalid external type values without adding physical claims.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Record-level connector map, SMBIOS version and enum exception policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware metadata cannot establish actual connector population, shape or electrical/link behavior; those require separate evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different connector enum for a board revision or None for an internal-only record, but must bind the override to the exact Type 8 identity and applicable SMBIOS definition.
expected_evidence: Approved board/chassis revision, record-level external connector map, SMBIOS version and enum exception policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 8 records with handle, raw external connector enum, decoded label, both designators/types and port type
Per-record expected/actual enum comparison including None/unknown handling
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot table/diff
Engineer verdict; any physical/link evidence explicitly separate

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a read-only External Connector Type metadata and reboot-persistence check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field is safely enumerable in software; missing project map or reboot approval is execution readiness, not an irreducible ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum provenance, complete record identity and valid None/unknown semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps the physical-claim and reboot safeguards while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under locked V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates deterministic SMBIOS validation from optional physical/link inspection and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents an isolated decoded connector label from being accepted without raw enum, endpoint semantics or unambiguous record attribution.
independent_technical_reasoning: External Connector Type is a structured Type 8 enum; with a version-aware expected map, collection, decoding, comparison and reboot persistence are deterministic software operations.
